comments.note: ClassCache.php — Maintainability: The docblock has been correctly trimmed to only value-adding annotations. @phpstan-param class-string|null $instanceOf is the correct PHPStan carve-out; @return class-string[] provides array element narrowing; @throws FileHelper_Exception documents propagated exception. No redundant @param lines remain. Minimal and clean.

Best Practices: constraints.md rule is placed correctly in the Strict Typing section. The @phpstan-param carve-out is concrete (example: class-string narrowing) and actionable. Future developers have clear guidance on when to annotate vs. rely on native types.

Security & Performance: Replacing docblock-only annotation with a native runtime union type is a safety improvement — invalid argument types now produce a PHP TypeError at the method boundary rather than propagating silently. No performance implications.

Non-blocking: $instanceOf parameter has no prose @param description explaining its purpose (filter results to instances of a given class). Since ClassCache is an internal utility and @phpstan-param covers analysis needs, this is acceptable as-is. A future pass could add a brief description for IDE tooling benefit.
